chapter.title: Bounty Hunters Guild
chapter.summary: Get licensed and climb from Probationary to Guild Member.

objectives.title: "Tracker Training Permit Certification"
objectives.why: Your first bounty license. It unlocks Very Low Risk Target (VLRT) bounties and makes you a Probationary Guild Member.

steps.do: Accept "Tracker Training Permit Certification" in Contracts and pay the 500 aUEC fee.
Fly to the target and destroy it.
steps.done_when: The certification completes and VLRT bounties start to appear.

objectives.title: Reach Junior Guild Member (3,000 rep)
objectives.why: VLRT bounties from microTech ("Active Bounty") and ArcCorp ("Wanted by ArcCorp") give 4,000 Guild reputation, enough in one kill. Hurston ("Wanted") and Crusader VLRTs give only 500 (about 6 kills).

steps.do: Accept an "Active Bounty: <target> (VLRT)" (microTech) or "Wanted by ArcCorp: <target> (VLRT)".

steps.done_when: "Tracker Beginner's Permit Certification" is offered in Contracts.

steps.do: Accept "Tracker Beginner's Permit Certification" and pay the fee.

objectives.title: Reach Guild Member (10,000 rep)
objectives.why: Each LRT bounty gives 1,000 Guild reputation and pays 5,000 aUEC.

steps.do: Take LRT bounties (for example "Active Bounty: <target> (LRT)"). Count each kill here.
steps.done_when: "Tracker License Certification" is offered in Contracts.

steps.do: Accept "Tracker License Certification" and pay the fee.
